notes.title: GUIDANCE Demo AMA and feedback gathering
notes.notes:
Hey there!  As you likely already know, the current demo came unto the scene of Steam on the first of this month, October; filled with all sorts of new changes and updates, and an increased polish from previous iterations (for those of you who are mega-OG)!

Seeing that it's been a while, I wanted to take this opportunity to have an AMA, and more importantly, a chance to ask YOU what YOU thought of the demo.
Now, I'm not sure exactly what you call that, but in so many words, I'd like to hear what you favorite, and least favorite parts of playing the demo were, and what you thought overall.

If you made any videos of yourself playing it as well, you're free to post them in the comments (unless Steam doesn't allow you to.  In which case, please post them elsewhere where I can see them ^.^)

Overall, this is a chance for us to hang out and interact a bit, and a chance for me to get some of your thoughts, and you to get mine.

Now that I've said the same thing five different ways, the purpose of this post should be abundantly clear, and I can peace out.  I hope you have a very pleasant time ^.^

Oh, and if you want to check out the [url=https://gamejolt.com/p/the-new-guidance-demo-has-been-out-since-the-1st-of-october-have-rmmtvree]corresponding post on my Game Jolt[/url], you can as well.
